description: Every method in Vectors/methods.json at its region, a place far from it and a southern-hemisphere place, on 2026's equinoxes and solstices, with rounding turned off. Each day also appears with the preset exactly as published; when minute rounding makes that day fragile, it moves to the next day that isn't.
